## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

---

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

- Q4 FY26（截至 2026-06-30）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$39,306 百万**（来源：`press_release.txt`，"Revenue in Intelligent Cloud was $39.3 billion and increased 32%"）
- Q4 FY25（截至 2025-06-30）Intelligent Cloud 收入：**$29,878 百万**（来源：`press_release.txt` 分部对照表）

同比增长率 = ($39,306 − $29,878) / $29,878 = $9,428 / $29,878 ≈ **31.6%**，四舍五入为 **32%**。

按恒定汇率口径为 31%（来源同上）。

---

### 2. 管理层在财报电话会上的归因（逐条引用）

来源：`transcript.txt`（位置 24808–25460）

| 归因 | 原文引用 |
|------|----------|
| **Azure 强劲增长（+43%）** | *"In Azure and other cloud services, revenue grew 43%, against a prior year that included accelerating growth. Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity. Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."* |
| **Azure 增量产能被快速变现** | *"That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."* |
| **GitHub Copilot 消费超预期** | *"Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."* |
| **本地服务器业务（on-premises server）持平（−1% 恒定汇率）** | *"In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."* |
| **分部毛利率变动因素** | *"Segment gross margin dollars increased 24% and gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure, as well as the continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand, partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure."* |
| **运营费用增长** | *"Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments noted earlier."* |
| **运营利润增长 31%** | *"Operating income grew 31% and operating margins, with a strong focus on efficiencies and investment returns, were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%."* |

---

### 3. 归因分类：已发生事实 vs. 前瞻性表述

| 归因 | 分类 | 区分依据 |
|------|------|----------|
| Azure 收入增长 43%（报告口径） | **已发生的事实** | 直接引述 Q4 实际报告数据："*revenue grew 43%*"——动词为过去式，且为已公布财报数字 |
| 客户持续需求超过可用产能 | **已发生的事实** | "*Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity*"——用现在进行时描述本季度观察到的状态，且电话会是在 Q4 结束后召开的回顾性会议 |
| CPU/GPU 机群效率提升带来超预期 | **已发生的事实** | "*Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet*"——"was ahead" 过去式，描述已实现的效率收益 |
| 流程改善使新产能更早交付 | **已发生的事实** | "*process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity*"——已实现的流程改进，且与"in-quarter capacity was quickly monetized"衔接 |
| 本季度 Azure 增量产能被快速变现 | **已发生的事实** | "*That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized*"——"was" 过去式，描述本季度已发生的变现 |
| GitHub Copilot 消费超预期（6 月定价模式调整后） | **已发生的事实** | "*stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change*"——6 月已发生的模式变更，结果是已观察到的 |
| 本地服务器业务因合同组合带来更高的当期确认 | **已发生的事实** | "*Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts*"——"were" 过去式，描述已实现的合同确认时点效应 |
| 销售结构向 Azure 转变拖累毛利率百分比 | **已发生的事实** | "*gross margin percentage decreased year-over-year primarily driven by sales mix shift to Azure*"——已发生的结构性变化 |
| AI 基础设施持续扩张以满足增长需求 | **已发生的事实** | "*continued scaling of our AI infrastructure ahead of growing demand*"——"continued" 表明是本季度持续进行且已发生的行为 |
| Azure 效率持续提升部分对冲毛利下滑 | **已发生的事实** | "*partially offset by ongoing efficiency gains in Azure*"——"ongoing" 描述本季度已发生的效率改善 |
| 运营费用增长 10% 由共享 R&D 驱动 | **已发生的事实** | "*Operating expenses increased 10% driven by the shared R&D investments*"——已实现的费用增长 |
| 分部运营利润率基本持平于 41% | **已发生的事实** | "*operating margins... were relatively unchanged year-over-year at 41%"——已实现的财务结果 |
| **展望：H1 增长预计加速** | **前瞻性表述** | "*Even with the strong close to Q4, we continue to expect H1 growth to accelerate.*"——"continue to expect" + 将来时态，是管理层对未来半年的预期 |
| **展望：Azure 全年增长约 45%（恒定汇率）** | **前瞻性表述** | "*In Azure, we expect revenue growth of approximately 45% in constant currency*"——"we expect"，明确的前瞻指引 |
| **展望：客户持续需求超过供给** | **前瞻性表述** | "*we remain focused on delivering efficiencies that help us bridge the gaps we see as customer demand continues to exceed supply*"——"remain focused" + "continue to exceed" 构成对未来状态的持续判断 |
| **展望：全年 Azure 增速季度间波动** | **前瞻性表述（提醒）** | "*as a reminder, year-over-year Azure growth rates can vary quarter-to-quarter based on capacity timing and contract mix*"——是管理层对未来不确定性的提醒 |

**区分依据总结**：
- **已发生事实**：使用过去时态（"was/were/grew/demonstrated"）、直接引用已公布数据、描述本季度/已完结期间的可观察结果。
- **前瞻性表述**：使用"we expect/continue to expect/remain focused"、"as a reminder"等引导词，且描述的是未来季度（FY27 Q1 指引）或持续性的未来预期；即便使用了 "continue"，只要是对未来状态的预期性使用，仍属前瞻。
